items.q: Whose turn is it to do the watering this week?

items.answer: Cut back the boundary hedge (Dot, due 28 Feb 2027); Clear the drainage ditch (Hal, due 1 Mar 2027); Return the borrowed rotavator (Josef, due 10 Mar 2027); Renew the public liability insurance (Tomas, due 14 Mar 2027).

items.q: What does Priya need to do before the committee meeting on Thursday 18 March?
items.answer: Book the skip for the clear-out by Wednesday 17 March (the permit has come through), and send round the AGM minutes by Thursday 18 March (the draft is done).

items.q: Is anything waiting on the council? If so, what?
items.answer: Yes — fixing the main gate lock (waiting on the Council estates team) and replacing the water meter (waiting on the council; visit not booked yet).

items.q: Who is going to repaint the noticeboard?
items.answer: Nobody — the task has no one’s name on it

items.q: Has the number of manure loads been decided? If so, how many?
items.answer: No — the number of loads is to be decided at the meeting.
